Pinned.description:
A reference to a record pinned to the git blob it was read at, such as
the brief a review read.

blob.description: The git blob id of the record as it was read.

description:
`review/brief/v1`, at /reviews/<id>/brief: what a change's author asks a review to look at.

`range` is the commits under review as `base..head`, both full commit ids,
and `subject` the record under review at its blob; a brief has one of them.
`focus` says what matters and what to check first, `questions` what the
author wants answered, and `follows` the report this brief continues from.
title: BriefRecord
